definitions.explanation: A thin, cylindrical sushi roll made with a half sheet of nori, containing a single filling such as tuna, cucumber, or pickled daikon.

examples.japanese: {細巻|ほそま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{六本|ろっぽん}→六本：27650_roppon⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered six thin sushi rolls.

examples.japanese: ⟦かっぱ{巻|ま}き→かっぱ巻き：28783_kappamaki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{細巻|ほそま}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Cucumber rolls are a classic thin sushi roll.

examples.japanese: ⟦{太巻|ふとま}き→太巻き：16202_futomaki⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{細巻|ほそま}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一口|ひとくち}→一口：10474_hitokuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧。
examples.english: Thin rolls are easier to eat in one bite than thick rolls.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ (thin) and {巻|ま}き (roll). The most basic type of sushi roll, using a half sheet of ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ and typically containing just one ingredient. Common varieties include {鉄火巻|てっかま}き (tuna roll), ⟦かっぱ{巻|ま}き→かっぱ巻き：28783_kappamaki⟧ (cucumber roll), and {納豆巻|なっとうま}き (natto roll).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細巻|ほそま}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to roll thin sushi rolls
- {細巻|ほそま}き⟦{一本|いっぽん}→一本：08888_ippon⟧: one thin roll
- {細巻|ほそま}き⟦セット→セット：03853_setto⟧: thin roll assortment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{太巻|ふとま}き→太巻き：16202_futomaki⟧: thick sushi roll — uses a full sheet of nori with multiple fillings
- {手巻|てま}き: hand roll — cone-shaped, eaten by hand
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧: rolled sushi — the general category
- {裏巻|うらま}き: inside-out roll — rice on the outside
